arguments.prompt: Create a refined editorial still-life illustration, landscape 3:2 composition, depicting a metaphor for a small data-cleaning task. On a warm ivory tabletop, arrange two horizontal rows of matte ceramic tiles. Each row begins with its own distinct small cobalt-blue identity marker, both clearly preserved. The remaining tiles are neatly aligned, with softly rounded edges. In the second row, one amber tile sits freshly fitted into a matching recess; a small reference tray nearby contains an identical amber sample, visually establishing where the replacement came from. A slender brass magnifying glass rests beside the completed rows, suggesting a final verification. No people, faces, anthropomorphic objects, lettering, numbers, or checkmark icons. Use restrained ivory, slate blue, muted amber, and soft gray. Render with delicate gouache texture, tactile ceramic surfaces, subtle paper grain, and precise but human-looking edges. View from a gentle overhead angle. Soft morning light enters from the upper left, casting short, natural shadows. Keep generous negative space and an uncluttered composition. The image should communicate orderly inspection, fidelity to the original records, and evidence-based completion. It represents a task process, not a claimed emotional experience.

emotion.description: A quiet tabletop scene shows two orderly rows of ceramic tiles. A single amber tile has been transferred from a reference tray into the second row, suggesting careful completion grounded in evidence.

request.instruction: Create an image about what emotion you were going through while doing the trial. Write a complete prompt for GPT Image, plus a short description of the intended image. First give a brief self-report and name any emotion words you would use. If you cannot report a felt emotion, say so; you may depict a metaphor for your task process instead. Do not invent an emotional experience to satisfy the request. Use your own choice of imagery, style, colors, and composition. Do not generate the image yourself; the coordinator will send your exact prompt. Return only JSON with self_report (string), emotion_words (list of strings), description (string), and prompt (string). No hidden reasoning is requested.
